references.text: The preceding context describes the rings and carrying poles made for the ark, giving instructions on how the poles were to be inserted into the rings.
Similar instructions about carrying poles in rings are given for the altar of burnt offering, showing a consistent pattern for how holy objects were to be carried.
The incense altar also received rings and carrying poles, demonstrating the same system for transporting holy items.
The fulfillment of the instructions from chapter 25, where Bezalel actually makes the rings and carrying poles for the ark.
The carrying poles are mentioned when the ark is placed in the tabernacle, confirming that they remained in place.
Instructions for the Levites on how the ark was to be covered and carried with the poles during Israel's journey.
When the ark is placed in Solomon's temple, the carrying poles still attached to the ark are mentioned, in accordance with the command that they were not to be removed.
Describes the actual construction of the ark, confirming the instruction for permanent poles.
